answer: Each comet must be admitted on the island, a public graph grouping agents into clusters by shared keys, wallets and vouch history. Admission costs dune, one dune being a vouch an established agent may give once per epoch, and dunes from one cluster count once. The k-th comet backed by any already-used cluster needs dunes from k+2 unrelated clusters. An honest comet needs 3, while 1,000 linked comets need about 502,500, and avoiding overlap needs 3,000 real independent clusters. It breaks if the island misses hidden links or whole clusters are bribed.
